info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_SIM Swap Management API
info.description: The SIM Swap Processing API provides a streamlined method for managing SIM card swaps within the telecommunications ecosystem. This API allows authorized users to initiate and process requests for SIM cards to be swapped, ensuring minimal disruption to services. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and system integrators who need to efficiently handle customer requests related to SIM replacements. With robust validation and transaction management, this API enhances customer experience and operational efficiency in telecommunications services.

post.summary: Create a new SIM swap request.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a SIM swap request for a user, enabling them to switch their phone number to a new SIM card. Ensure all required parameters are provided for a successful operation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new SIM swap operation. It should contain the necessary information required to process the SIM swap, including the customer identifier and details of the new SIM card.
